# Actor classes in ViZDoom (ZDoom 2.8.1, Doom 2 / Freedoom)

Classes defined by the engine's built-in DECORATE (`vizdoom.pk3`). Use these names in
`SpawnSpot`, `Thing_Spawn` (via SpawnNum), DECORATE `ACTOR Name : Parent`, and map things
(via DoomEdNum). A parent class that is not in this file does not exist in this engine
(e.g. `PowerupNone`), and the WAD will fail to load. Numbers come from the Doom 2 MAPINFO chain
(`mapinfo/doom2.txt` and its includes), which is what `freedoom2.wad` uses.

Provenance:

- Engine: ViZDoom 1.3.2 (ZDoom 2.8.1+ fork)
- Compiler: ACC 1.60 (Oct 18 2023)
- `src/vizdoom/wadsrc/static/decorate.txt` (sha256 `5487d6144c68`)
- `src/vizdoom/wadsrc/static/mapinfo/doom2.txt` (sha256 `33be0b437235`)
- `src/vizdoom/wadsrc/static/mapinfo/doomcommon.txt` (sha256 `000266517c1b`)
- `src/vizdoom/wadsrc/static/mapinfo/doomitems.txt` (sha256 `93357b536cf7`)
- `src/vizdoom/wadsrc/static/mapinfo/common.txt` (sha256 `24eb16f9aa28`)
